name: Lornoxicam
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Acute mild to moderate pain (Xefo Rapid tablets; arthritis regimens differ)
usual_adult_dose.dose: 8 to 16 mg/day in 8 mg doses; 16 mg then 8 mg after 12 hours on day 1; maximum 16 mg/day thereafter
Reduce to once-daily dosing (avoid at CrCl <30, our judgment)

key_interactions.action: Avoid other NSAIDs; caution with the rest.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Warfarin and other anticoagulants; heparin with neuraxial anesthesia
key_interactions.effect: More bleeding; spinal or epidural hematoma.
key_interactions.action: Monitor INR; caution with neuraxial procedures.

key_interactions.effect: Less blood-pressure effect; kidney injury and hyperkalemia.
key_interactions.action: Monitor blood pressure, kidney function and potassium.

common: Nausea, abdominal pain, dyspepsia, diarrhea, vomiting
serious: Acute kidney failure in pre-existing kidney impairment

contraindications: Severe kidney impairment (serum creatinine above 700 µmol/L)
Active or recurrent peptic ulcer or bleeding
monitoring: Hemoglobin, creatinine and liver enzymes beyond 3 months

pk.half_life_eskd: No significant change in kidney failure (SmPC)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 42% in urine (mainly metabolite), 50% in feces

sources.citation: Takeda UK Limited. (2015). Xefo Rapid 8 mg film-coated tablets (lornoxicam) [Summary of product characteristics, licence PA1547/005/004; text revised April 2015]. Health Products Regulatory Authority (Ireland).

revision_log.change: Dose row labeled as Xefo Rapid acute-pain dosing; arthritis regimens differ.
